role_summary: Owns multi-state sales tax compliance across Northwind's twelve production-entity LLCs, partnership tax provisions, and K-1 distribution. Reports to the Director of Tax.

capability_areas.name: Multi-state sales tax compliance
capability_areas.description: Owns sales tax across the twelve production-entity LLCs. Avalara experience preferred but not required.

capability_areas.name: Partnership tax provisions and K-1 distribution
capability_areas.description: Manages quarterly partnership tax provisions and the annual K-1 distribution.

capability_areas.name: Close coordination with finance
capability_areas.description: Partners with finance leadership on close coordination, especially during production wrap.

depth_distinction.builder_definition: By Q3 owns the multi-state sales tax close end-to-end across the twelve production-entity LLCs. Builder is the year-two state.
depth_distinction.user_definition: Year-one bar: shadows the Director through Q1, operates the Director's existing process competently, inherits ownership through Q3.
depth_distinction.edge_case_guidance: A candidate who can't credibly take ownership by Q3 is not a fit even if year-one shadowing would go fine.

minimum_bar_description: CPA required. At least one year of in-house experience inside the six-plus years total. Pure public-accounting profiles do not pass.
